name: SCUM
tagline: Native connector for SCUM dedicated servers: one UE4SS mod inside SCUMServer.exe that connects to Takaro itself, no sidecar.
requirements: SCUM Windows dedicated server (Steam app 3792580) build named in the release
File access to the server's SCUM\Binaries\Win64 folder

assets.label: Server mod (UE4SS included)
assets.hint: Stop the server, unzip into SCUM\Binaries\Win64 (next to SCUMServer.exe), copy ue4ss\Mods\TakaroSCUM\TakaroConfig.txt.example to TakaroConfig.txt, paste the registration token and start the server.
